summary: Pyxus International and holding companies Pyxus Parent and Pyxus Holdings entered a Transaction Support Agreement effective November 5, 2026 with supporting creditors (Glendon, Intermarket, Owl Creek, Acasta, Concise, Park West, Northeast Investors) holding roughly 74.9% of Pyxus Term Loans, 67.9% of Intabex Term Loans, and 56.0% of the 8.50% Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2027. The holders back out-of-court exchange transactions, including a Notes Exchange Offer, to be launched after filing. Terms beyond support levels are not yet specified. Watch launch timing, participation thresholds and any holdout risk.
